sheets.text:
Little Otter,
Crack, Crack!

A little shell. A tasty surprise.

Look! A shell.
A little shell.

One little shell!

A little stone.
On my tummy!

On my tummy. Ready to tap!

Shell up high.
Ready, steady...

Ready to tap!

Tap, tap.
Crack, crack!

Crack! The shell is open.

An open shell!
A tasty bite inside.

A tasty little bite!

A little bite.
Yum, yum!

Yum, yum! A tasty bite.

Lick, lick.
Clean little paws.

Clean paws. All done!

Full little tummy.
Float, float.
Time to rest.

Rest well, Little Otter.
